config.label: LinkedIn access token from the OAuth Token Generator
config.description: LinkedIn access token from the OAuth Token Generator. Accepts a bare token or 'Bearer <token>'. Required for EEA/Switzerland members only.

config.label: How long fetched LinkedIn data is cached in memory, e
config.description: How long fetched LinkedIn data is cached in memory, e.g. 30m, 2h, 1d, or 0 to turn caching off. Defaults to 6h.
